```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)
library(htmltools)

# Read athlete data and sort by weight class and points
athletes <- read_csv("data/athletes.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  arrange(weight_class, desc(points_scored), name)

# Helper function for clean place badges (highlight only podium, simplify others)
get_place_badge <- function(place) {
  case_when(
    place == "1st" ~ '<span class="badge-gold">🥇 1st</span>',
    place == "2nd" ~ '<span class="badge-silver">🥈 2nd</span>',
    place == "3rd" ~ '<span class="badge-bronze">🥉 3rd</span>',
    place %in% c("4th", "5th", "6th", "7th", "8th") ~ sprintf('<span class="badge-place">%s</span>', place),
    TRUE ~ '<span style="color: #94a3b8; font-weight: bold;">—</span>'
  )
}

# Unique options
weight_classes <- sort(unique(athletes$weight_class))
seasons <- sort(unique(athletes$season), decreasing = TRUE)
num_schools <- length(unique(athletes$team))

weight_options_html <- paste(
  sprintf('<option value="%s">%s lbs</option>', weight_classes, weight_classes),
  collapse = ""
)

season_options_html <- paste(
  sprintf('<option value="%s">%s</option>', seasons, seasons),
  collapse = ""
)

rows_html <- paste(
  sprintf('<tr data-wc="%s" data-season="%s"><td style="font-weight: 600;">%s</td><td style="color: #334155;">%s</td><td>%s lbs</td><td>%s</td><td style="text-align: center; font-weight: 500;">%s</td><td style="text-align: right; font-weight: 600; color: #1e3a8a;">%s</td><td style="text-align: center; color: #64748b;">%s</td></tr>',
          athletes$weight_class, athletes$season, athletes$name, athletes$team, athletes$weight_class, get_place_badge(athletes$place), athletes$record, athletes$points_scored, athletes$season),
  collapse = ""
)

HTML(paste0(
  '<div class="stats-grid">',
  '  <div class="stat-card"><div class="stat-number">', nrow(athletes), '</div><div class="stat-label">Total Wrestlers</div></div>',
  '  <div class="stat-card"><div class="stat-number">', num_schools, '</div><div class="stat-label">Programs Represented</div></div>',
  '  <div class="stat-card"><div class="stat-number">10</div><div class="stat-label">Weight Classes</div></div>',
  '  <div class="stat-card"><div class="stat-number">', length(seasons), '</div><div class="stat-label">Championship Seasons</div></div>',
  '</div>',
  '<div class="filter-card">',
  '  <div style="display: flex; gap: 1rem; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: flex-end;">',
  '    <div style="flex: 1; min-width: 220px;">',
  '      <label for="wrestlerSearch">Search Wrestler or School</label>',
  '      <input type="text" id="wrestlerSearch" class="form-control" placeholder="Type a name or school..." oninput="resetPageAndFilter()" style="padding: 0.45rem;">',
  '    </div>',
  '    <div>',
  '      <label for="weightClassSelect">Weight Class</label>',
  '      <select id="weightClassSelect" class="form-select" style="min-width: 180px; padding: 0.45rem;" onchange="resetPageAndFilter()">',
  '        <option value="all">All Weights</option>',
  weight_options_html,
  '      </select>',
  '    </div>',
  '    <div>',
  '      <label for="seasonSelect">Season</label>',
  '      <select id="seasonSelect" class="form-select" style="min-width: 130px; padding: 0.45rem;" onchange="resetPageAndFilter()">',
  '        <option value="all">All Seasons</option>',
  season_options_html,
  '      </select>',
  '    </div>',
  '  </div>',
  '  <div id="wrestlerCount" style="margin-top: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #475569;">Showing all wrestlers</div>',
  '</div>',
  '<div class="table-wrapper">',
  '<table id="wrestlerTable" class="table table-hover">',
  '<thead><tr><th>Wrestler</th><th>Team</th><th>Weight</th><th>Place</th><th style="text-align: center;">Record</th><th style="text-align: right;">Points</th><th style="text-align: center;">Season</th></tr></thead>',
  '<tbody>', rows_html, '</tbody>',
  '</table>',
  '<div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: 0.75rem 1.25rem; background: #f8fafc; border-top: 1px solid #e2e8f0;">',
  '  <button id="prevBtn" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary" onclick="changePage(-1)" style="border-radius: 6px; padding: 0.3rem 0.8rem;">← Previous</button>',
  '  <span id="pageInfo" style="font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; color: #475569;">Page 1</span>',
  '  <button id="nextBtn" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary" onclick="changePage(1)" style="border-radius: 6px; padding: 0.3rem 0.8rem;">Next →</button>',
  '</div>',
  '</div>',
  '<script>',
  'let currentPage = 1;',
  'const pageSize = 20;',
  'let matchingRows = [];',
  '',
  'function resetPageAndFilter() {',
  '  currentPage = 1;',
  '  filterWrestlers();',
  '}',
  '',
  'function filterWrestlers() {',
  '  const selectedWeight = document.getElementById("weightClassSelect").value;',
  '  const selectedSeason = document.getElementById("seasonSelect").value;',
  '  const search = (document.getElementById("wrestlerSearch").value || "").toLowerCase().trim();',
  '  const allRows = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll("#wrestlerTable tbody tr"));',
  '  ',
  '  matchingRows = allRows.filter(row => {',
  '    const matchWeight = (selectedWeight === "all" || row.getAttribute("data-wc") === selectedWeight);',
  '    const matchSeason = (selectedSeason === "all" || row.getAttribute("data-season") === selectedSeason);',
  '    const matchSearch = (!search || row.textContent.toLowerCase().includes(search));',
  '    return matchWeight && matchSeason && matchSearch;',
  '  });',
  '  ',
  '  allRows.forEach(r => r.style.display = "none");',
  '  ',
  '  const totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(matchingRows.length / pageSize));',
  '  if (currentPage > totalPages) currentPage = totalPages;',
  '  ',
  '  const start = (currentPage - 1) * pageSize;',
  '  const end = start + pageSize;',
  '  matchingRows.slice(start, end).forEach(r => r.style.display = "");',
  '  ',
  '  const countEl = document.getElementById("wrestlerCount");',
  '  if (countEl) {',
  '    countEl.textContent = "Showing " + matchingRows.length + " wrestlers (" + (matchingRows.length ? (start + 1) : 0) + "–" + Math.min(end, matchingRows.length) + ")";',
  '  }',
  '  const pageInfo = document.getElementById("pageInfo");',
  '  if (pageInfo) {',
  '    pageInfo.textContent = "Page " + currentPage + " of " + totalPages;',
  '  }',
  '  const prevBtn = document.getElementById("prevBtn");',
  '  const nextBtn = document.getElementById("nextBtn");',
  '  if (prevBtn) prevBtn.disabled = (currentPage <= 1);',
  '  if (nextBtn) nextBtn.disabled = (currentPage >= totalPages);',
  '}',
  '',
  'function changePage(delta) {',
  '  currentPage += delta;',
  '  const totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(matchingRows.length / pageSize));',
  '  if (currentPage < 1) currentPage = 1;',
  '  if (currentPage > totalPages) currentPage = totalPages;',
  '  const allRows = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll("#wrestlerTable tbody tr"));',
  '  allRows.forEach(r => r.style.display = "none");',
  '  const start = (currentPage - 1) * pageSize;',
  '  const end = start + pageSize;',
  '  matchingRows.slice(start, end).forEach(r => r.style.display = "");',
  '  const countEl = document.getElementById("wrestlerCount");',
  '  if (countEl) {',
  '    countEl.textContent = "Showing " + matchingRows.length + " wrestlers (" + (start + 1) + "–" + Math.min(end, matchingRows.length) + ")";',
  '  }',
  '  const pageInfo = document.getElementById("pageInfo");',
  '  if (pageInfo) pageInfo.textContent = "Page " + currentPage + " of " + totalPages;',
  '  const prevBtn = document.getElementById("prevBtn");',
  '  const nextBtn = document.getElementById("nextBtn");',
  '  if (prevBtn) prevBtn.disabled = (currentPage <= 1);',
  '  if (nextBtn) nextBtn.disabled = (currentPage >= totalPages);',
  '}',
  '',
  'function makeTableSortable(tableId) {',
  '  const table = document.getElementById(tableId);',
  '  if (!table) return;',
  '  const headers = table.querySelectorAll("thead th");',
  '  headers.forEach((th, colIdx) => {',
  '    th.style.cursor = "pointer";',
  '    th.title = "Click to sort";',
  '    th.setAttribute("data-title", th.textContent.trim());',
  '    th.textContent = th.getAttribute("data-title") + " ↕";',
  '    let asc = true;',
  '    th.addEventListener("click", () => {',
  '      const tbody = table.querySelector("tbody");',
  '      const rows = Array.from(tbody.querySelectorAll("tr"));',
  '      rows.sort((a, b) => {',
  '        const valA = a.children[colIdx].textContent.trim();',
  '        const valB = b.children[colIdx].textContent.trim();',
  '        const numA = parseFloat(valA);',
  '        const numB = parseFloat(valB);',
  '        if (!isNaN(numA) && !isNaN(numB)) {',
  '          return asc ? numA - numB : numB - numA;',
  '        }',
  '        return asc ? valA.localeCompare(valB) : valB.localeCompare(valA);',
  '      });',
  '      rows.forEach(r => tbody.appendChild(r));',
  '      headers.forEach(h => {',
  '        h.textContent = h.getAttribute("data-title") + " ↕";',
  '      });',
  '      th.textContent = th.getAttribute("data-title") + (asc ? " ▲" : " ▼");',
  '      asc = !asc;',
  '      filterWrestlers();',
  '    });',
  '  });',
  '}',
  'makeTableSortable("wrestlerTable");',
  'resetPageAndFilter();',
  '</script>'
))
```
